existing_derivations.title: Quantitative Universality for a Class of Nonlinear Transformations
existing_derivations.abstract: The Feigenbaum constant δ ≈ 4.669 emerges from the functional equation governing period-doubling bifurcations. It is universal for all unimodal maps approaching chaos.

z_squared_connection: No clear Z² connection found in literature
physical_meaning: Universal ratio governing approach to chaos in period-doubling
mathematical_path: Start from fundamental laws (QFT/GR). Identify relevant Lagrangian. Use perturbation theory or exact solutions. Extract dimensionless ratio.
required_assumptions: No new physics beyond SM at relevant scales
